name: delivery
description: Delivery as Code gates, modeled as a subclassable component hierarchy.

delivery:index:Wake.description: The structured resume contract of an unmet gate: how it comes back to be re-checked.

params.description: Kind-specific resume parameters (a URL, a metric query, a policy ref, ...).

delivery:index:Gate.description: The abstract base gate. It awaits a boolean -- a build verdict, another gate's status, a plain expression -- suspending the rollout while the boolean is false and opening when it holds. Subclasses supply the boolean and the wake; the base owns the suspend/resume/status plumbing. Cannot be instantiated directly.

until.description: The boolean to await; the gate opens once it is true.

wake.description: How this gate resumes while `until` is false.

status.description: 'open' once the awaited boolean held, else 'pending'.

resumeWhen.description: The structured wake describing how this gate resumes.

delivery:index:ApprovalGate.description: A gate that opens when the named approvers sign off. Inherits all of Gate's suspend/resume/status machinery.

approvers.description: The identities whose sign-off opens the gate.

instructions.description: What the approver should check before signing off.

delivery:index:MetricGate.description: A gate that opens when a metric query stays under a threshold. Inherits all of Gate's suspend/resume/status machinery.

query.description: The metric query to evaluate (e.g. a Datadog or Prometheus expression).

threshold.description: The gate opens while the query result stays at or below this value.

delivery:index:Gate/explain.description: Returns a human-readable line describing why the gate is holding, for the operator watching a rollout. Inherited by every gate subclass.
